description: This PHP class defines an AWS SDK client for the AWS Clean Rooms Service, including method annotations for various API operations such as creating, deleting, retrieving, listing, and updating resources related to AWS Clean Rooms.

classes.name: CleanRoomsClient
classes.description: AWS SDK client for interacting with the AWS Clean Rooms service, providing methods to manage collaborations, schemas, policies, and related resources.

methods.name: batchGetCollaborationAnalysisTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves multiple collaboration analysis templates in a single request.

methods.name: createAnalysisTemplate
methods.description: Creates a new analysis template for AWS Clean Rooms.

methods.name: deleteMember
methods.description: Removes a member from a collaboration.
